description: Get details for one New Quizzes assessment: title, instructions, points and timing. Read-only. Uses the Quiz LTI API, which some schools do not expose to students. For Classic Quizzes use get_quiz.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

quiz_id.description: Quiz ID (numeric string). Get it from list_quizzes, or list_new_quizzes for New Quizzes.

name: get_new_quiz
